propositions: S3 remote operations without the git-remote-s3 helper (or with version < 0.3.2) silently corrupt the store by creating multiple bundles per ref; the system must fail closed early with an actionable error message.

Detect S3 mode by remote URL scheme (s3:// or s3+zip://) and guard store init and push operations with a preflight check that raises OptionalDependencyError unconditionally, independent of strict-mode, so it propagates and halts the write.
The S3 preflight must reuse already-resolved remote URLs from existing git calls (no new git-remote calls) and be injected at init time and before both synchronous and async push code paths.
When the remote URL is unresolvable or the remote does not exist, the system keeps its existing best-effort skip behavior and does not raise the S3 error.
With non-S3 remotes (file://, https://, etc.), the preflight is a no-op and no helper is required.
S3 mode detection requires no schema changes; the guard reuses the existing sync.remote field and its URL scheme.
